# espalier_container (Resource)

A container of the container runtime (`container create`), each a lightweight VM. Changing any argument except `running` replaces the container. Its addresses may change whenever it restarts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "espalier_image" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx:1.29-alpine"
}

resource "espalier_network" "apps" {
  name   = "apps"
  subnet = "192.168.100.0/24"
}

resource "espalier_volume" "cache" {
  name = "nginx-cache"
  size = "1G"
}

resource "espalier_container" "web" {
  name   = "web"
  image  = espalier_image.nginx.name
  cpus   = 1
  memory = "256M"
  env    = { NGINX_ENTRYPOINT_QUIET_LOGS = "1" }
  labels = { owner = "terraform" }

  networks = [
    { network = espalier_network.apps.name, aliases = ["web.apps.test"] },
  ]
  mounts = [
    { type = "bind", source = "/Users/me/site", target = "/usr/share/nginx/html", read_only = true },
    { type = "volume", source = espalier_volume.cache.name, target = "/var/cache/nginx" },
    { type = "tmpfs", target = "/tmp" },
  ]
  ports = [
    { host_ip = "127.0.0.1", host_port = 8080, container_port = 80 },
  ]
  cap_drop = ["CAP_NET_RAW"]
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = espalier_container.web.addresses[0].ipv4_address
}

# A locked-down worker: x86-64 image under Rosetta, unprivileged user,
# read-only root, own resolver, and an image from a local registry
# without TLS.
resource "espalier_container" "worker" {
  name      = "worker"
  image     = "localhost:5000/worker:1.0"
  scheme    = "http"
  platform  = "linux/amd64"
  rosetta   = true
  user      = "1000:1000"
  read_only = true
  init      = true
  shm_size  = "128M"
  cap_drop  = ["ALL"]

  dns = {
    nameservers    = ["192.168.100.53"]
    search_domains = ["apps.test"]
  }
  ulimits = [{ name = "nofile", soft = 4096, hard = 8192 }]
  mounts  = [{ type = "tmpfs", target = "/tmp" }]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image reference, resolved like `espalier_image`'s `name`. The runtime pulls it if it is missing; use `espalier_image` to control pulling and pin versions.
- `name` (String) Name of the container, also its hostname.

### Optional

- `cap_add` (Set of String) Linux capabilities to add, e.g. `CAP_NET_ADMIN`, or `ALL`.
- `cap_drop` (Set of String) Linux capabilities to drop, e.g. `CAP_MKNOD`, or `ALL`.
- `command` (List of String) The process to run, as a full argument list (its first element replaces the image's entrypoint). Defaults to the image's entrypoint and command.
- `cpus` (Number) Number of CPUs. Defaults to the runtime's `container.cpus` property.
- `dns` (Attributes) Resolver configuration. The runtime's defaults apply to whatever is not set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns))
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables, on top of the image's environment.
- `init` (Boolean) Run an init process that forwards signals and reaps zombies. Defaults to `false`.
- `init_image` (String) Image of the VM's init system, instead of the runtime's `vminit` image. Not reported, like `kernel`.
- `kernel` (String) Absolute host path of a custom kernel for the container's VM. Defaults to the runtime's kernel (see `espalier_system`). The runtime does not report it, so a change outside Terraform is not noticed, and import does not recover it.
- `kernel_args` (List of String) Arguments appended to the kernel command line, e.g. `["quiet"]`. Not reported, like `kernel`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels attached to the container.
- `masked_paths` (List of String) **Experimental in the runtime.** Absolute paths in the container to hide, in addition to the runtime's defaults (`/proc/kcore`, `/sys/firmware` and others). An element `NONE` drops the defaults and the paths before it, e.g. `["NONE"]` for none at all.
- `memory` (String) Memory in bytes, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix, e.g. `512M`. Defaults to the runtime's `container.memory` property.
- `mounts` (Attributes List) Filesystems to mount. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mounts))
- `networks` (Attributes List) Networks to attach, in order; the first is the primary one. Defaults to the runtime's `default` network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
- `no_dns` (Boolean) Leave the container without any DNS configuration (`--no-dns`). Conflicts with `dns`. Without either, the runtime configures its own resolver. Defaults to `false`.
- `platform` (String) Platform of a multi-platform image (`os/arch[/variant]`, e.g. `linux/amd64`, which runs with Rosetta). Defaults to the host's. The runtime records the variant: `linux/arm64` and `linux/arm64/v8` are the same.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Container ports to publish on the host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `publish_sockets` (Attributes List) Unix sockets in the container to publish on the host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--publish_sockets))
- `read_only` (Boolean) Mount the root filesystem read-only. Defaults to `false`.
- `read_only_paths` (List of String) **Experimental in the runtime.** Absolute paths in the container to mount read-only, in addition to the runtime's defaults (`/proc/sys`, `/proc/sysrq-trigger` and others). An element `NONE` drops the defaults and the paths before it, e.g. `["NONE"]` for none at all.
- `rosetta` (Boolean) Enable Rosetta, to run x86-64 binaries. Defaults to `false`.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the container should run. Changes start or stop it in place; a container stopped outside Terraform is started again. Defaults to `true`.
- `runtime` (String) Runtime handler (plugin) that runs the container. Defaults to `container-runtime-linux`.
- `scheme` (String) Registry scheme, `http` or `https`, for pulling the image if it is missing, e.g. `http` for a local registry without TLS. Defaults to `https`. Only used when pulling: the runtime does not record it, and changing it does not replace the container.
- `shm_size` (String) Size of `/dev/shm`, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix. Defaults to the runtime's.
- `ssh` (Boolean) Forward the host's SSH agent socket into the container. Defaults to `false`.
- `ulimits` (Attributes List) Resource limits of the process. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ulimits))
- `user` (String) User of the process, as `name`, `uid` or `uid:gid`. Defaults to the image's, else `0:0`.
- `virtualization` (Boolean) Expose virtualization to the container, for nested VMs; needs host and kernel support. Defaults to `false`.
- `workdir` (String) Working directory of the process. Defaults to the image's, else `/`.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) Addresses of the running container, one per network. Empty while it is stopped; they may change when it restarts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `id` (String) The container's name.
- `state` (String) State as the runtime reports it, e.g. `running` or `stopped`.

<a id="nestedatt--dns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns`

Optional:

- `domain` (String) Default domain.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameserver IP addresses.
- `options` (List of String) Resolver options, e.g. `ndots:2`.
- `search_domains` (List of String) Search domains.


<a id="nestedatt--mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mounts`

Required:

- `target` (String) Absolute path inside the container.
- `type` (String) `bind` (a host directory), `volume` (an `espalier_volume`) or `tmpfs`.

Optional:

- `read_only` (Boolean) Mount read-only. Defaults to `false`.
- `source` (String) Absolute host path for `bind`, volume name for `volume`; not set for `tmpfs`.


<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Required:

- `network` (String) Network name, e.g. an `espalier_network`'s `name`.

Optional:

- `aliases` (List of String) Additional DNS names of the container on this network. They must be fully qualified, e.g. `api.example.test`.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address, in lower case. Assigned when the container starts if not set; see `addresses` for the one in use.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the interface. Defaults to the runtime's.


<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `container_port` (Number) Container port.
- `host_port` (Number) Host port.

Optional:

- `host_ip` (String) Host address to listen on. Defaults to `0.0.0.0`, all IPv4 addresses.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` or `udp`. Defaults to `tcp`.


<a id="nestedatt--publish_sockets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `publish_sockets`

Required:

- `container_path` (String) Absolute path of the socket in the container.
- `host_path` (String) Absolute path of the socket on the host.


<a id="nestedatt--ulimits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ulimits`

Required:

- `hard` (Number) Hard limit.
- `name` (String) Limit, as `ulimit` names it without `RLIMIT_`, e.g. `nofile` or `nproc`.
- `soft` (Number) Soft limit.


<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_address` (String) IPv4 address with prefix length.
- `ipv4_gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address with prefix length.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address.
- `network` (String) Network name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Containers are imported by name.
terraform import espalier_container.sleeper sleeper
```
